review_candidates.title: Junior IT Support Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: As an IT Support Engineer, you will be responsible for providing enterprise-level assistance to our users. You will diagnose and troubleshoot software and hardware problems and help our users install applications and programs. Key Responsibilities: Ensure coordination and management of the IT Help Desk, and the timely resolution of requests in line with SLAs. Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, including account setup and network configuration. Maintain an accurate IT inventory and asset
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Qualifications: BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a relevant field. Experience: Proven internship experience in one of the following: computer networks, IT, System Administration, or 1+ years of experience in the mentioned fields. English proficiency is a must.
